newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Amcor issues US$30m convertible notes.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Amcor issues US$30m convertible notes.

text.p: Amcor Ltd said on Thursday it had issued an additional US$30 million of convertible notes on the same terms as a US$200 million issue announce in November.
Amcor said underwriters Merrill Lynch & Co had excercised an option to subscribe for an additional US$30 million worth of the subordinated, perpetual convertible notes on December 18.

Amcor said in November that the original issue had closed oversubscribed. The notes carry a coupon of 7.25 percent and are convertible into Amcor ordinary shares at any time up to November 2006 at a 13.5 percent premium to the November 12 closing price for Amcor U.S. ADRs, which was US$24-1/8.
The notes are rated A-minus by Standard & Poor's Corp and A-3 by Moody's Investor's Service
